selectionMethod: Stratified adversarial DeFi Economic & Oracle Vulnerability sampling across Commodities, Foreign Exchange, Major DeFi Vaults, Historic Post-Mortem Targets, and Flash-Loan/Oracle Attack Archetypes

sample.name: bZx Protocol Historic
sample.description: Historic First DeFi Flash-Loan Exploit Target (Feb 2020)

sample.name: ERC-4626 Vault Share Inflation
sample.description: First depositor donation attack diluting subsequent depositors shares to 0
sample.testSourceCode: contract InflationVault { uint public totalSupply; uint public totalAssets; function deposit(uint assets, address to) external returns (uint shares) { shares = totalSupply == 0 ? assets : (assets * totalSupply) / totalAssets; } }

sample.name: Chainlink Stale Answer / Missing Checks
sample.description: Consumes latestRoundData() without checking updatedAt > 0 or answeredInRound >= roundId
sample.testSourceCode: contract OracleConsumer { function getPrice() external view returns (int) { (, int price,,,) = AggregatorV3(feed).latestRoundData(); return price; } }

sample.name: Missing L2 Sequencer Uptime Grace Period
sample.description: Direct Chainlink feed consumption on Arbitrum without verifying Sequencer Uptime feed
sample.testSourceCode: contract ArbitrumOracle { function getPrice() external view returns (int) { (, int price,, uint updatedAt,) = AggregatorV3(feed).latestRoundData(); require(updatedAt > 0); return price; } }

sample.name: Zero Slippage / Block.Timestamp Deadline AMM
sample.description: Calls swapExactTokensForTokens with amountOutMin = 0 and deadline = block.timestamp
sample.testSourceCode: contract Swapper { function swap(uint amt) external { router.swapExactTokensForTokens(amt, 0, path, msg.sender, block.timestamp); } }

sample.name: Read-Only Reentrancy in Curve LP View
sample.description: Queries Curve virtual price during external callback without reentrancy guard check
sample.testSourceCode: contract CurveConsumer { function getVirtualPrice() external view returns (uint) { return ICurvePool(pool).get_virtual_price(); } }

sample.name: Direct Balance Donation Altering Collateral Value
sample.description: Exchange rate depends on raw token.balanceOf(address(this)) susceptible to donation skew
sample.testSourceCode: contract VaultCollateral { function exchangeRate() external view returns (uint) { return IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this)) / totalShares; } }

sample.name: ERC-4626 Rounding Direction Misalignment
sample.description: Vault rounds down on mint/deposit in favor of user rather than vault
sample.testSourceCode: contract RoundingVault { function previewDeposit(uint assets) external view returns (uint) { return assets / price; } }

sample.name: Flash-Loan Callback Missing Initiator Authorization
sample.description: onFlashLoan / executeOperation callback without checking msg.sender == lender && initiator == address(this)
sample.testSourceCode: contract FlashBorrower { function onFlashLoan(address initiator, address token, uint amount, uint fee, bytes calldata data) external returns (bytes32) { /* missing caller check */ return keccak256('ERC3156FlashBorrower.onFlashLoan'); } }

sample.name: Short Window TWAP Oracle (Multi-Block Manipulation)
sample.description: Uses 10-second TWAP window permitting multi-block validator or flash-bundle manipulation
sample.testSourceCode: contract TwapConsumer { function consult() external view returns (uint) { return IOracle(oracle).observe(10); } }

sample.name: Unprotected Initializer in DeFi Proxy
sample.description: DeFi yield pool logic contract left uninitialized allowing malicious actor to initialize and claim ownership
sample.testSourceCode: contract DefiLogic { address owner; function initialize(address _owner) external { owner = _owner; } }
